minutes.headline: School Committee approved an internal superintendent job posting and a 12-person screening committee to begin the search.
minutes.summary: This special meeting, held mostly to act on the superintendent search following Dr. Burnham's planned retirement, opened and closed public comment with none offered, then went into a roughly half-hour executive session on non-union personnel matters. After returning, the committee reviewed draft timelines for an internal-first, external-if-needed search process, and voted to approve the internal job posting and to authorize a call for a diverse 12-person screening committee, with search timeline dates left flexible.

what_happened.line: School Committee voted 3-0 to approve the internal job posting for Superintendent of Lunenburg Public Schools.
School Committee voted 3-0 to authorize a call for a 12-person screening committee to help run the search.
The votes followed a closed executive session on non-union personnel matters, with no public comment offered either before or after.
The committee chose not to reserve specific seats (such as Select Board or public safety) on the screening committee, planning instead to assemble a diverse pool once applications arrive.
Members discussed a possible special meeting around January 29 to appoint the screening committee sooner and start subcommittee work in early February.

why_it_matters: This starts the process for choosing the district's next superintendent, following the current superintendent's planned retirement.
Residents interested in serving may apply to the 12-person screening committee once the call goes out, rather than being appointed to a designated seat.
Salary and contract terms for the new superintendent remain open for negotiation with the school committee, not fixed by the posting.
